title: NullPointerException Fix
problem: The code throws a NullPointerException because the string is never initialized. Fix it so it prints HELLO in uppercase.
starterCode: class Main{ public static void main(String[] args){ String s = null; System.out.println(s.toUpperCase()); } }

title: Array Index Out of Bounds
problem: The loop goes one index too far and causes ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException. Fix the loop so it prints all 4 elements: 10 20 30 40.
starterCode: class Main{ public static void main(String[] args){ int[] arr = {10, 20, 30, 40}; for(int i = 0; i <= arr.length; i++){ System.out.print(arr[i] + " "); } } }

title: Integer Overflow
problem: Multiplying two large ints overflows. Fix the data type so the result 3000000000 is printed correctly.
starterCode: class Main{ public static void main(String[] args){ int a = 100000; int b = 30000; System.out.println(a * b); } }

title: Wrong String Equals
problem: The code uses == to compare strings which compares references, not content. Fix it to correctly print YES when both strings are equal.
starterCode: class Main{ public static void main(String[] args){ String a = new String("hello"); String b = new String("hello"); if(a == b){ System.out.println("YES"); } else { System.out.println("NO"); } } }
